jobs.description:
Build highly scalable, client facing platforms using Java, Spring Boot and Azure Cloud.

• Do you want to design and build enterprise scale, client facing applications using Java, Spring Boot, and cloud native technologies on Azure?
• Are you excited by distributed systems, high availability, and platforms used daily by clients across the globe?
• If you’re looking to start your career in a high energy, international agile environment that strongly encourages learning and professional growth, take your next career step with UBS.

As part of your team, you will

• •Design, build, and maintain highly scalable, first tier client facing applications within Wealth Management.
• •Develop cloud native services using Java, Spring, Spring Boot, and modern engineering practices.
• •Work on distributed systems running on Azure Cloud and managed AKS (Azure Kubernetes Service).
• •Use Redis and other data technologies to build low latency, resilient platforms.
• •Collaborate closely with product owners, UX, and business stakeholders to understand and refine requirements.
• •Apply Agile and DevOps principles, contributing across the full SDLC (design, development, testing, release, and support).
• •Write clean, testable code and contribute to TDD, code reviews, and architectural discussions.
• •Ensure solutions meet high standards for performance, security, reliability, and operational excellence.
• •Investigate incidents, perform root cause analysis, and help continuously improve platform stability.
• •Document solutions clearly and share knowledge within the team and wider engineering community.

Tech Graduate Program
• You will participate in our immersive global Tech Graduate Program, designed to accelerate your development as a software engineer. The program offers:
• •Hands on experience from day one on real, business critical platforms.
• •Exposure to cutting edge technologies including cloud, containers, and distributed systems.
• •Professional development through structured learning, certifications, and engineering communities.
• •Guidance from experienced engineers and architects who will mentor and support your growth.
• •A collaborative, international environment where you learn from peers across regions.
• •Career advancement through an 18 month comprehensive program starting in August 2026, setting you up for long term success at UBS.

jobs.title: FX/MM Settlements Operations
jobs.description:
Are you interested in making an impact in the fast-paced world of foreign exchange? Join a team where your attention to detail and problem-solving skills play a valuable role in global financial markets. Find out how you can make an impact.
You will play a key role in ensuring accurate and timely processing of foreign exchange & money market transactions. In this role, you will support the business, manage post-trade processes, mitigate operational risk, and adhere to control frameworks while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Trade Settlement & Confirmation
• Ensure accurate and timely settlement of FX (spot, forward, swap, NDF, options) and MM transactions.
• Perform trade validation
• Manage confirmation processes—including paper, SWIFT, and electronic confirmations (e.g., FXAll, Mysis, GTSS)
• Resolve trade breaks and unmatched confirmations promptly.
2. Intraday Payment Processing
• Generate and release settlement payments (MT103/202) through the payment platforms.
• Monitor incoming/outgoing cash flows to ensure settlement obligations are met on value date.
• Coordinate with Reconciliation teams to investigate and resolve cash breaks.
3. Business & Stakeholder Interaction
• Liaise closely with front office, middle office, and clients regarding settlement queries.
• Collaborate with internal teams (Credit, Onboarding, Trade Capture) to resolve counterparty issues.
• Communicate proactively with counterparties, custodians, and settlement banks ensuring efficient processing.
4. Risk & Controls
• Identify, escalate, and mitigate settlement risk, operational risk, and market cut off risk.
• Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements related to reporting, confirmations, and recordkeeping.
• Regular preparation of risk reports.
5. Exception Management
• Investigate and resolve settlement discrepancies, fails, and breaks.
• Track and report settlement fails; identify root causes and drive long term resolutions.
• Manage CLS (Continuous Linked Settlement) trade submission, matching, and dispute resolution where applicable.
6. Process Improvement & Technology
• Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency within settlement workflows.
• Participate in system upgrades, UAT testing, and new product or market rollouts.
• Ability to work under pressure with tight deadlines and market cut offs.
• Strong problem solving and analytical abilities.
• Team oriented.

jobs.description:

– Act as an Onboarding & KYC Advisor to client advisor on onboarding and Periodic KYC Review (PKR) cases across the WM. Understand and articulate KYC requirements and work with client advisor through the onboarding and PKR processes.

– Support client advisor on non-KYC aspects of PKR (i.e. file conversion for archival, raise additional name search request to middle office, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) review, PKR case manager management.
• – Think flexibly to propose new ideas and contribute to continuous improvement of processes and services.
• – Be-able to act as mentor for junior teammates and cascade management message in an effective and accurate manner
• – Be a trusted partner of market as well as other business partners.

Sei incredibilmente organizzato con un occhio per i dettagli? Hai un alto orientamento al servizio clienti e una consapevolezza del rischio? Ti piace lavorare con i colleghi di tutta l'organizzazione e sei bravo con la gestione degli stakeholder? Stiamo cercando qualcuno del genere per:
– Agire come consulente onboarding & KYC al consulente client su onboarding e casi periodici KYC Review (PKR) attraverso il WM. Comprendere e articolare i requisiti KYC e lavorare con il consulente client attraverso i processi di bordo e PKR.
– Sii proattivo e risponda tempestivamente alle domande dei partner commerciali e di mercato. Facilitare la gestione eccezionale su approccio basato sul rischio e coordinare con Business e Financial Crime / Compliance per il signoff.
Controllo di sfondo di revisione screening sul cliente, fornire supporto sul profilo cliente con consulente cliente, e raccogliere materiale di prova di conferma dove disponibile. Supporto consulente clienti per garantire la conformità normativa dei materiali presentati dal cliente e dal consulente clienti stessi.
– Maniglia Periodic KYC Review (PKR) recensione caso dall'inizio alla fine, compresi gli aggiornamenti del profilo cliente dopo aver consultato con il consulente del cliente. Inoltre, eseguire attività di controllo del profilo KYC collegate alle richieste di imbarco del cliente e garantire la coerenza delle informazioni del cliente KYC con i controlli di qualità PKR.
– Consulente client di supporto sugli aspetti non-KYC di PKR (cioè la conversione di file per l'archiviazione, sollevare richiesta di ricerca di nome aggiuntivo all'ufficio centrale, escalate for Due Diligence Officer (DDO) recensione, gestione case manager PKR.
• – Pensa in modo flessibile a proporre nuove idee e contribuire al miglioramento continuo dei processi e dei servizi.
• – Essere in grado di agire come mentore per i compagni di squadra junior e il messaggio di gestione della cascata in modo efficace e preciso
• – Essere un partner affidabile del mercato così come altri partner commerciali.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie unglaublich organisiert mit einem Auge für Details? Haben Sie eine hohe Kundendienstorientierung und ein hohes Risikobewusstsein? Arbeiten Sie gerne mit Kollegen in der gesamten Organisation zusammen und sind Sie gut mit Stakeholder Management? Wir suchen jemanden wie diesen, um:
Handeln Sie als Onboarding & KYC Advisor für Kundenberater bei Onboarding- und Periodic KYC Review (PKR) Fällen im gesamten WM. Verstehen und artikulieren Sie die KYC-Anforderungen und arbeiten Sie mit dem Kundenberater durch die Onboarding- und PKR-Prozesse.
Seien Sie proaktiv und reagieren Sie rechtzeitig auf die Anfragen von Markt- und Geschäftspartnern. Erleichtern Sie den außergewöhnlichen Umgang mit dem risikobasierten Ansatz und koordinieren Sie sich mit Business and Financial Crime / Compliance für die Abmeldung.
Überprüfen Sie das Hintergrundüberprüfungs-Screening auf dem Client, unterstützen Sie das Kundenprofil mit dem Kundenberater und sammeln Sie, soweit verfügbar, Nachweismaterial. Unterstützen Sie den Kundenberater, um die Einhaltung der von Kunden und Kundenberatern eingereichten Materialien selbst zu gewährleisten.
Behandeln Sie die periodische KYC Review (PKR) Fallprüfung von Anfang bis Ende, einschließlich Aktualisierungen des Kundenprofils nach Rücksprache mit dem Kundenberater. Führen Sie außerdem KYC-Profilprüfungsaktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Client-Onboarding-Anfragen durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass die KYC-Informationen des Kunden mit den PKR-Qualitätsprüfungen übereinstimmen.
- Unterstützung des Kundenberaters bei Nicht-KYC-Aspekten von PKR (d. H. Dateikonvertierung für die Archivierung, zusätzliche Namenssuchanfrage an das Middle Office, Eskalation für die Überprüfung des Due Diligence Officer (DDO), PKR Case Manager Management.
• - Denken Sie flexibel, um neue Ideen vorzuschlagen und zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Prozessen und Dienstleistungen beizutragen.
• - in der Lage sein, als Mentor für Junior-Teamkollegen und Cascade-Management-Nachricht in einer effektiven und genauen Weise zu handeln
• - Seien Sie ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner des Marktes sowie anderer Geschäftspartner.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous incroyablement organisé avec un œil pour le détail? Avez-vous une forte orientation vers le service à la clientèle et une sensibilisation aux risques élevés? Vous aimez travailler avec des collègues de l'ensemble de l'organisation et êtes-vous bon avec la gestion des intervenants? On cherche quelqu'un comme ça pour :
– Agir en tant que conseiller à bord et KYC auprès du conseiller client dans les cas d'inspection et d'examen périodique des KYC (PKR) dans l'ensemble du MG. Comprendre et articuler les exigences de KYC et travailler avec le conseiller client par l'entremise des processus de bord et de PKR.
– Soyez proactif et répondez en temps opportun aux questions du marché et des partenaires commerciaux. Faciliter la gestion exceptionnelle de l'approche fondée sur le risque, et coordonner avec la criminalité commerciale et financière / Conformité pour l'approbation.
Examiner la vérification des antécédents du client, fournir du soutien sur le profil du client avec le conseiller du client et recueillir des preuves de corroboration, le cas échéant. Appuyer le conseiller client pour assurer la conformité réglementaire des documents soumis par le client et le conseiller client lui-même.
– Gérer l'examen périodique des cas de KYC (PKR) du début à la fin, y compris les mises à jour du profil du client après avoir consulté le conseiller client. En outre, effectuer des activités de vérification de profil KYC liées aux demandes de client à bord et assurer la cohérence des informations KYC client avec les vérifications de qualité PKR.
– Soutenir le conseiller client sur les aspects non-KYC de PKR (c.-à-d. la conversion de fichiers pour les archives, soulever la demande de recherche de nom supplémentaire au bureau intermédiaire, augmenter pour l'examen de l'agent de diligence raisonnable (ODD), la gestion de cas de PKR.
• – Pensez avec souplesse pour proposer de nouvelles idées et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus et des services.
• – Être capable d'agir comme mentor pour les coéquipiers juniors et le message de gestion de cascade de manière efficace et précise

jobs.title: Premises Operations & Key Project Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Exploitation des locaux et gestionnaire de projet clé

jobs.description:
Are you solid as a rock when delivering large projects with set deadlines and budget? Are you passionate about corporate real estate portfolio strategy? Do you know how to manage and motivate teams? Are you interested in sustainability topics, from environmental management to LEED certifications? Do you like to analyze complex data?

This role includes assisting the team with strategic planning and management of the real estate portfolio for all UBS AUS/NZ offices, includes all AUS/NZ premises projects and related activities for UBS. For the first 18 months this role will assume the responsibility of Project Sponsor for the new UBS Sydney office project. This will require leadership of the project team taking responsibility to deliver the new Sydney office to the agreed time frame and budget allocated.

Major responsibilities would include:

Real Estate:
- Involvement with Real estate short and long term strategy, negotiation with Landlord directly or through real estate consultants for any lease related transaction
- Real estate planning, space planning / optimisation solutions for changing with business requirements
- Prepare recommendation papers and seek property and cost approvals for minor works projects from UBS management within designated areas of responsibility and in line with limits of delegation
- Managing and vetting the AUS/NZ Rental Invoices on a monthly basis to ensure the data is accurate to recommend for approval
- The ongoing development and issuing of monthly occupancy space utilisation reports
- Ensure AUS/NZ comply with Regional requirements relating to the supervision of 3rd Party Real Estate providers

Projects and Churn Management:
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for projects including office fit-outs (new and old), churns, office refurbishment and office stacking
- Work closely with Real Estate team locally and regionally (business management included) to provide Real Estate support that is consistent and coherent with the global framework in each of the UBS offices
- Generate RFP's for tenders with fair value recommendations working with the Procurement team
- Programme management of projects allowing successful planning in line with operating procedures for each phase of work, from start through to handover
- Monitor & proactively recommend workplace asset replacement / refurbishment in line with lifecycle / workplace conditions
- Prepare recommendation papers for business cases defining costs and benefit analysis
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations for reporting on space allocation and premise vacancy to be charged back and issued to business departments
- Consistent application of Real Estate related tools

Site Operations:
- Interact effectively with UBS internal business partners and establish a balanced engagement model with each of them and work with them in a professional and proactive challenging approach to ensure a balance between businesses requests and Real Estate strategy and policies.
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ facilities operations on cost management, budget and forecasting
- Overall management of external Integrated Facilities Management service provider which includes SLA's to ensure KPI's are being achieved, monthly reporting, QBR reviews and performance management
- Manage all UBS AUS/NZ locations in corporate real estate and operations for incident management and escalation, business continuity / contingency planning
- Establish and maintain strong and effective working relationships with all business department managers
- Develop and maintain effective lines of communication to create best in class service delivery to all business partners and project stakeholders
- Manage and monitor regular workplace and condition inspections, ensuring the work items are appropriately instructed Include regular interaction with key business unit contacts to ensure satisfaction
- Provide managerial guidance to the local delivery teams and resolve first level enquiries
- WH&S ongoing development and management

titleByLocale.it: Credit Risk Officer - Fondi di copertura
titleByLocale.fr: Agent de risque de crédit - Fonds de couverture

jobs.description:
Are you naturally curious and ambitious? Do you have sharp analytical skills and a background in counterparty credit risk in hedge funds?

We’re looking for a Credit Risk Officer like you who can:

• evaluate counterparty credit risk based on an understanding of the hedge fund and family office risk management techniques, trading strategies, and infrastructure, as well as a number of other quantitative and qualitative measures of credit worthiness. This will include client due diligence visits for onsite evaluations.
• hold delegated personal authority (within established risk-based limits) to approve new positions or to make recommendations to higher authority levels within Credit. The candidate will be expected to interact with the business units in relation to transactions to ensure the risk fit UBS's ultimate appetite in the sector.
• evaluate transactional risks associated with OTC derivatives, securities financing, exchange traded derivatives, banking products and structured transactions
• prepare, as well as review and approve, written counterparty annual reviews/transactional credit proposals drawing conclusions relating to credit assessment, risk appetite, exposure drivers and business prospects
• lead trading documentation negotiation including ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage and Repo Agreements
• ensure all regulatory requests, audit items and operational risk issues are dealt with in a disciplined, timely and efficient manner
• perform ad hoc credit risk analysis and participate in portfolio reviews to identify risk developments or concentrations

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sei naturalmente curioso e ambizioso? Hai competenze analitiche affilate e uno sfondo nel rischio di credito controparte nei fondi di copertura?

Stiamo cercando un responsabile del rischio di credito come lei che può:

• valutare il rischio di credito controparte basato su una comprensione delle tecniche di gestione del rischio di hedge fund e family office, strategie di trading e infrastrutture, nonché una serie di altre misure quantitative e qualitative della pena di credito. Ciò includerà le visite di diligenza dei clienti per le valutazioni in loco.
• deteneva l'autorità personale delegata (entro i limiti stabiliti a rischio) per approvare nuove posizioni o per formulare raccomandazioni ai livelli di autorità superiori all'interno del credito. Si prevede che il candidato interagirà con le unità aziendali in relazione alle transazioni per garantire il rischio adatto all'ultimo appetito di UBS nel settore.
• valutare i rischi transazionali associati a derivati OTC, finanziamento di titoli, derivati scambiati, prodotti bancari e transazioni strutturate
• preparare, oltre a rivedere e approvare, controparte scritta recensioni annuali / proposte di credito transazionale che traducono conclusioni relative alla valutazione del credito, appetito del rischio, driver di esposizione e prospettive di business
• negoziazione di documenti di trading di piombo tra cui ISDA/CSA, Prime Brokerage e Repo Accordi
• garantire che tutte le richieste normative, gli elementi di audit e le questioni di rischio operative siano trattate in modo disciplinato, tempestivo ed efficiente
• eseguire analisi del rischio di credito ad hoc e partecipare a recensioni di portafoglio per identificare gli sviluppi dei rischi o le concentrazioni
descriptionByLocale.de:
Sind Sie von Natur aus neugierig und ehrgeizig? Haben Sie scharfe analytische Fähigkeiten und einen Hintergrund im Gegenparteiausfallrisiko bei Hedgefonds?

Wir suchen einen Credit Risk Officer wie Sie, der kann:

• Bewertung des Gegenparteiausfallrisikos auf der Grundlage eines Verständnisses der Hedgefonds- und Family-Office-Risikomanagementtechniken, Handelsstrategien und Infrastruktur sowie einer Reihe anderer quantitativer und qualitativer Maßnahmen zur Kreditwürdigkeit. Dazu gehören Kunden-Due-Diligence-Besuche für Vor-Ort-Bewertungen.
• Beauftragte persönliche Autorität (innerhalb festgelegter risikobasierter Grenzen) besitzen, um neue Positionen zu genehmigen oder Empfehlungen an höhere Autoritätsebenen innerhalb von Credit zu geben. Es wird erwartet, dass der Kandidat mit den Geschäftseinheiten in Bezug auf Transaktionen interagiert, um sicherzustellen, dass das Risiko dem ultimativen Appetit von UBS in der Branche entspricht.
• Bewertung der Transaktionsrisiken im Zusammenhang mit OTC-Derivaten, Wertpapierfinanzierung, börsengehandelten Derivaten, Bankprodukten und strukturierten Transaktionen
• Erstellung, Überprüfung und Genehmigung von schriftlichen jährlichen Überprüfungen von Gegenparteien/Transaktionskreditvorschlägen, wobei Schlussfolgerungen in Bezug auf Bonitätsbeurteilung, Risikobereitschaft, Expositionstreiber und Geschäftsaussichten gezogen werden
• Lead Trading Dokumentation Verhandlungen einschließlich ISDA / CSA, Prime Brokerage und Repo-Vereinbarungen
• sicherstellen, dass alle aufsichtsrechtlichen Anforderungen, Prüfungselemente und operationellen Risiken diszipliniert, zeitnah und effizient bearbeitet werden
• Durchführung einer Ad-hoc-Kreditrisikoanalyse und Teilnahme an Portfolioüberprüfungen zur Identifizierung von Risikoentwicklungen oder -konzentrationen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Êtes-vous naturellement curieux et ambitieux ? Avez-vous de solides compétences analytiques et une formation en risque de crédit de contrepartie dans les fonds spéculatifs?

Nous cherchons un agent de risque de crédit comme vous qui peut :

• évaluer le risque de crédit de contrepartie sur la base d'une compréhension des techniques de gestion des risques du fonds spéculatif et des bureaux familiaux, des stratégies de négociation et de l'infrastructure, ainsi que d'un certain nombre d'autres mesures quantitatives et qualitatives de la solvabilité. Cela comprendra des visites de diligence raisonnable pour les évaluations sur place.
• détenir des pouvoirs personnels délégués (dans les limites établies en fonction du risque) pour approuver de nouveaux postes ou faire des recommandations à des niveaux d'autorité supérieurs au sein du Crédit. On s'attendra à ce que le candidat interagisse avec les unités commerciales relativement aux transactions afin de s'assurer que le risque correspond à l'appétit ultime d'UBS dans le secteur.
• évaluer les risques transactionnels associés aux produits dérivés de gré à gré, au financement de titres, aux produits dérivés négociés en bourse, aux produits bancaires et aux transactions structurées;
• préparer, ainsi qu'examiner et approuver, les examens annuels écrits des contreparties/propositions de crédit transactionnelle en tirant des conclusions concernant l'évaluation du crédit, l'appétit pour les risques, les facteurs d'exposition et les perspectives d'affaires;
• négociation de la documentation commerciale principale, y compris l'ISDA/CSA, les accords de courtage de premier rang et de prise en pension
• s'assurer que toutes les demandes réglementaires, les éléments de vérification et les questions liées aux risques opérationnels sont traités avec rigueur, rapidité et efficacité
• effectuer une analyse ad hoc des risques de crédit et participer à l'examen des portefeuilles pour identifier les évolutions ou les concentrations des risques

jobs.description:
Do you have a passion for safeguarding the environment? Do you want to be part of the bank’s journey to net zero operations? Do you have a keen eye for efficiency to shape a lean approach to our decarbonization program?

We’re looking for a candidate who will:
• Support our Global Lead for Energy Management to develop a robust energy management system aligned with ISO 50001, building consensus with regional teams.
• Assist site and project teams to create comprehensive energy management plans and conduct measurement and verification assessments to demonstrate initiative effectiveness.
• Contribute to the evaluation of environmental risk management within the bank’s risk management framework, ensuring well-designed and executed mitigation plans.
• Co-ordinate Energy Management Governance regional working groups focused on decarbonization and meter data coverage of utility operations, progressing activities in line with agreed timelines and milestones.
• Analyse and calculate utility consumption to assist regional teams with consumption forecasts and renewable energy certificate purchases.

You will be directly involved in day-to-day project operations, gaining business-specific exposure from professionals with different areas of expertise within Group Real Estate and Supply Chain (GRESC). You’ll have the opportunity to see beyond your internship. If you’re ready to work where no two days are the same, this internship is for you.

Stiamo cercando un candidato che:
• Supporta il nostro Global Lead for Energy Management per sviluppare un robusto sistema di gestione dell'energia allineato con ISO 50001, creando un consenso con i team regionali.
• Assistere i team del sito e del progetto per creare piani di gestione energetica e condurre valutazioni di misura e verifica per dimostrare l'efficacia dell'iniziativa.

• Koordinieren Sie die regionalen Arbeitsgruppen für Energiemanagement-Governance, die sich auf die Dekarbonisierung und die Erfassung von Zählerdaten des Versorgungsbetriebs konzentrieren und die Aktivitäten gemäß den vereinbarten Zeitplänen und Meilensteinen vorantreiben.
